gates.detector: held-out one-vs-rest AUROC >= 0.70 (point estimate) AND >= 20 held-out positives
gates.repair: >= 20 hard episodes AND Wilson 95% lower bound of rescue rate >= 0.50 AND <= 10% of clean successes lost when the repair is forced on them
gates.targets: ADOPTED if repairs PASS >= 24/28 AND detectors PASS >= 27/28, else NOT_ADOPTED
gates.guarantee: do-no-harm dispatch: threshold lambda fitted by conformal risk control on out-of-fold clean TRAIN queries so that E[Hit@5 lost on a clean query] <= ALPHA; PASS if held-out clean loss <= ALPHA; also report 200 calibration re-splits
gates.natural: report, not gated: (a) real misspelled ESCI queries whose corrected spelling was typed by another ESCI user, gold from ESCI labels; (b) in-corpus superseded policy versions with the validity filter off, no injected docs. Metrics: Hit@5 before, after closed loop (guarded and unguarded), after oracle repair, oracle-referenced closure
gates.unseen: report, not gated: leave-one-fault-out attributor; on the held-out fault test episodes report flagged rate, right-group rate and Hit after dispatch
